description: This file implements functions and structures related to X509 public keys in the OpenSSL library, including encoding, decoding, and thread-safe access to EVP_PKEY objects within X509_PUBKEY structures.

methods.name: X509_PUBKEY_set
methods.description: Encodes an EVP_PKEY into an X509_PUBKEY structure, handling DER encoding and decoding.

methods.name: X509_PUBKEY_get
methods.description: Retrieves the EVP_PKEY from an X509_PUBKEY structure, re-encoding and parsing if necessary, with thread safety.

methods.name: X509_PUBKEY_set0_param
methods.description: Sets parameters of an X509_PUBKEY, including algorithm identifier and public key data.

methods.name: X509_PUBKEY_get0_param
methods.description: Extracts parameters from an X509_PUBKEY, such as algorithm object, key data, and algorithm structure.

methods.name: X509_PUBKEY_get0_public_key
methods.description: Returns the public key bit string from an X509_PUBKEY.
